text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: SYNTH-CANARY-008 — canary 'canary-edge-eu1' failing synthetic checks (auth bounce / 5xx pattern). PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456

PagerDuty: Incident automatically assigned to Samir (primary on-call).

Irene (SRE): acked in PD. I'm on it — first glance: prober logs show repeated 401s while trying to refresh tokens to auth service, started ~2m ago after canary run.

Samir (Infra): seeing same. Logs: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z canary-edge-eu1 prober[pid=423] WARN auth: refresh failed status=401 body="invalid_client"
2026-03-15T10:12:07Z canary-edge-eu1 prober[pid=423] WARN attempt=2 auth: refresh failed status=401
2026-03-15T10:12:09Z canary-edge-eu1 prober[pid=423] ERROR check-runner: check failed status=502 upstream=auth.internal
```

Jake (Devex): FYI I merged the prober token refresh change earlier today (deploy 2026-03-15T10:11Z) — it altered the client_id header formatting. Rolling that back might fix it.

Maria (Prod): quick customer impact check: CS reports one small EU customer (acme-corp) hit intermittent 500s on embed requests at 10:13Z for ~30s. Most traffic unaffected. Marking possible limited customer impact. Not severe yet, but worth escalating if canary doesn't stabilize.

Samir (Infra): temporary mitigation: stopping canary fanout to reduce noise and avoid cascading auth retries. Doing a controlled stop now.

IncidentBot: canary 'canary-edge-eu1' halted by @Samir.

Irene (SRE): created incident ticket INC-2026-345 and added runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/synth-canary-failures. Linking auth runbook and previous similar RCA.

PagerDuty: No ack from secondary within 8m -> auto-escalate to Maria (secondary).

Maria (Prod): taking over incident. Pinging @auth-team to confirm any recent client credential rotation or rate-limits on token endpoint.

Samir (Infra): quick patch deployed to prober config: add retry/backoff for token refresh + fallback to cached token for 60s. Command I ran: 
```
# temporary change to prober config
prober.auth.retry_policy = { "max_retries": 3, "backoff_ms": 1500 }
prober.auth.use_cached_token_on_failure = true
```
Restarting prober runner (will be a short blip).

Irene (SRE): running a local curl to the token endpoint to reproduce: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://auth.internal/oauth/token -d 'grant_type=client_credentials' -H 'Client-ID: canary-prober'
```
Response shows 401 when client id header omitted/changed. Looks like JWT client formatting bug.

Jake (Devex): reverting my earlier header formatting change in the prober patchset now and re-deploying a small canary-only image. If that clears, we can re-enable full fanout.

Maria (Prod): summary so far: root cause likely bad client header formatting in prober token refresh code pushed at 10:11, causing auth endpoint to reject and synthetic checks to fail. Customer impact limited but measurable for a tiny subset. Next actions: 1) verify the revert fixes auth 2) re-enable canary and watch 30m 3) PD incident stays open until stability window met 4) postmortem if regression confirmed.

Samir (Infra): revert deployed to canary image — re-enabling fanout in 30s and will monitor.

IncidentBot: PagerDuty note: PD123456 acknowledged by Irene, assigned to Samir, escalated to Maria.

Irene (SRE): monitoring dashboards — canary failures dropping to zero after revert, EU embed error rate dropping back toward baseline. Tagging :white_check_mark: once stable for 5m.

Maria (Prod): will keep incident open; plan to create a short blameless postmortem and schedule a follow-up with DevEx and Auth teams. Thanks all for quick coordination.

Samir (Infra): leaving a TODO in the runbook to add a pre-deploy canary header validation step.

Jake (Devex): noted, sorry for churn — will add a preflight unit to prober CI.

Irene (SRE): closing timeline note: incident opened 10:12Z, mitigation deployed 10:16Z, canary stable 10:20Z. Will update ticket and PD after 30m stable window.

PagerDuty: PD incident PD123456 set to status: investigating -> monitoring (will auto-resolve after stability window).

Maria (Prod): thanks everyone. Leaving on-call handover to Samir in case of regression.

Samir (Infra): ack and standing by.
